## Internet

- **eduroam** (if you have it) should work!
- **CalvinGuest** (if you don't have eduroam)
    - connect to [**CalvinGuest**](https://calvin.edu/offices-services/information-technology/guests/wireless-access) and follow instructions to register

## Workshop Materials {.smaller}

### posit.cloud

- Log in to your [posit.cloud](https://posit.cloud/) account
- *Share posit.cloud email with Stacy* (`stacy.deruiter@calvin.edu`)
- You'll be added to the space "Applied Regression Workshop"
- In the space...
  - Click blue "New Project" bubble
  - Choose "+ New Project From Template"
  - Choose the template **arm-workshop-materials**
